form.label: AD Objects - Windows App - Performance
form.description: Dashboard for analyzing performance around Windows Application Installs and Crashes.

search.query: `ms__obj_win_perfmon_index` instance="_Total" | fields host,counter, object, Value, instance | stats count by counter,object,instance,host
fields host | stats count by host | sort host
search host="$tok_perf_host$" | fields object | stats count by object | sort object
search host="$tok_perf_host$" object="$tok_perf_obj$" | fields counter | stats count by counter | sort counter

`ms_obj_win_events_application` [| inputlookup ms_ad_obj_app_eventcodes where state_type="error" | stats values(EventCode) AS EventCode | format | table search] host="$tok_perf_host$*" | fields _time,_raw,sourcetype,host,Event_Name,Report_Status,Report_Id,fault_bucket,Attached_Files,Response,Cab_Id,P1,P2,P3,P4,P5,P6,P7,P8,P9,P10,EventCode,Message,Type,SourceName | rex max_match=0 "(?:\<EventData\>)\<Data\>\<\/Data\>\<Data\>(?<fault_bucket>[^\<]+)\<\/Data\>\<Data\>(?<Event_Name>[^\<]+)\<\/Data\>\<Data\>(?<Response>[^\<]+)\<\/Data\>\<Data\>(?<Cab_Id>[^\<]+)\<\/Data\>\<Data\>(|(?<P1>[^\<]+))\<\/Data\>\<Data\>(|(?<P2>[^\<]+))\<\/Data\>\<Data\>(|(?<P3>[^\<]+))\<\/Data\>\<Data\>(|(?<P4>[^\<]+))\<\/Data\>\<Data\>(|(?<P5>[^\<]+))\<\/Data\>\<Data\>(|(?<P6>[^\<]+))\<\/Data\>\<Data\>(|(?<P7>[^\<]+))\<\/Data\>\<Data\>(|(?<P8>[^\<]+))\<\/Data\>\<Data\>(|(?<P9>[^\<]+))\<\/Data\>\<Data\>(|(?<P10>[^\<]+))\<\/Data\>\<Data\>(|(?<Attached_Files>[^\<]+))\<\/Data\>\<Data\>(|(?<Attached_Files_other>[^\<]+))\<\/Data\>\<Data\>(|(?<Analysis_symbol>[^\<]+))\<\/Data\>\<Data\>(|(?<Solution_recheck>[^\<]+))\<\/Data\>\<Data\>(|(?<Report_Id>[^\<]+))\<\/Data\>\<Data\>(|(?<Report_Status>[^\<]+))\<\/Data\>" | eval trigger="$tok_show_crash$" | join type=left EventCode [|inputlookup ms_ad_obj_app_eventcodes | table EventCode,LogName,signature,state,more_info] | eval Response=if(isnull(Response),if(isnull(signature),signature,Message),Response) | eval Event_Name=if(isnull(Event_Name),state,Event_Name),P1=if(isnull(P1),SourceName,P1) | eval state=if(isnull(Type),state,Type) | search state!="Information" | fillnull value="NA" P1,P2,P3,P4,P5,P6,P7,P8,P9,P10,fault_bucket,cab_id,Report_Id,Report_Status,Response | eval application=if(Event_Name=="APPCRASH",P1." (version: ".P2.")",Event_Name),app_file=if(Event_Name=="APPCRASH",P1,if(match(Event_Name,"WindowsUpdateFailure"),"Wuauclt.exe",Event_Name)) | eval annotation_label = application | eval annotation_category = Event_Name

`ms__obj_win_perfmon_index` host="*" host="$tok_perf_host$" object="$tok_perf_obj$" counter="$tok_perf_counter$" | fields _time,host,Value | eval trigger="$tok_show_crash$" | timechart avg(Value) as Average by host

`ms_obj_win_events_all` [| inputlookup ms_ad_obj_app_eventcodes where state_type="install" | stats values(EventCode) AS EventCode by LogName| format | table search] host="$tok_perf_host$*" | fields _time,_raw,host,EventCode,product_*,install_*,Message,LogName,Channel,SourceName | eval trigger="$tok_show_install$" | eval LogName=if(isnull(LogName),Channel,LogName) | join type=left EventCode [|inputlookup ms_ad_obj_app_eventcodes | table EventCode,signature,state,more_info] | rex max_match=0 "(?:\<Application\>)(?<application>[^\<]+)" | eval product_name=if(n_apps=1,application,if(n_apps>1,"Multiple Apps",if(isnull(product_name),Policy_Name,product_name))) | eval install_msg=if(isnull(install_msg),signature,install_msg) | eval product_path=if(match(product_name,"\x5C{1}"),product_name,NULL) | rex field=product_path "(\{|\x5C{1})(?<product_name>[\{\}a-zA-Z0-9._\-]+)(\}$|$)" | rex field=install_transaction "(\{|\x5C{1})(?<product_name>[\{\}a-zA-Z0-9._\-]+)(\}$|$)" | eval install_msg_state=case(match(install_msg,"Ending"),"Ending",match(install_msg,"Beginning"),"Beginning",match(install_msg,"(?si)(Removed|Removal)"),"Removed",match(install_msg,"(?si)installed"),"Installed",match(install_msg,"(?si)Installation.*completed successfully"),"Installed",match(install_msg,"(?si)failed"),"Failed") | eval install_state=if(isnull(state),install_msg_state,state),product_name=if(isnull(product_name),SourceName,product_name) | table _time,host,LogName,SourceName,EventCode,product_path,product_name,install_state,install_msg,more_info,Message,_raw,signature | eval annotation_label = product_name | eval annotation_category = install_state

`ms__obj_win_perfmon_index` host="$tok_perf_host$" object="$tok_perf_obj$" counter="$tok_perf_counter$" | fields _time,host,Value | eval trigger="$tok_show_install$" | timechart avg(Value) as Average by host

| table _time,_raw,sourcetype,host,application,Event_Name,P1,P2,P3,P4,P5,P6,P7,P8,P9,P10,fault_bucket,cab_id,Report_Id,Report_Status,Response,Attached_Files,Attached_Files_other,app_file | eval Attached_Files=if(isnull(Attached_Files),if(isnull(Attached_Files_other),"NA",mvjoin(Attached_Files_other,"|")),if(isnull(Attached_Files_other),mvjoin(Attached_Files,"|"),mvjoin(Attached_Files,"|")."| Other: -".mvjoin(Attached_Files_other," - "))) | eval Problem_Signature="P1: ".P1."|P2: ".P2."|P3: ".P3."|P4: ".P4."|P5: ".P5."|P6: ".P6."|P7: ".P7."|P8: ".P8."|P9: ".P9."|P10: ".P10."|Attached Files: ".Attached_Files | eval Info="Time: ".strftime(_time,"%m/%d/%y %I:%M:%S %P")."|Host: ".host."|Event Name: ".Event_Name."|sourcetype: ".sourcetype."|Fault Bucket: ".fault_bucket."|Response: ".Response."|Cab ID: ".cab_id."|Report ID: ".Report_Id."|Report Status Code:".Report_Status | table Info,Problem_Signature | makemv delim="|" Problem_Signature | makemv delim="|" Info
